required.name: NeoForge
required.why: The mod loader itself. This is a NeoForge mod — it will not load on Fabric, and the old Forge builds are a separate, older branch.

required.name: GeckoLib
required.why: Drives every animated model in the mod — bosses, shadows, weapons. Nothing renders correctly without it, and a 5.x build will not work.

optional.name: Better Combat
optional.why: The mod ships dedicated Better Combat support: SLR weapons get proper attack animations and swing arcs instead of the vanilla flail. The single biggest feel upgrade you can install.

optional.name: Sodium
optional.why: Rendering performance. SLR throws a lot of particles and shader work at the screen during boss fights, and Sodium is what keeps that playable on modest hardware.

optional.name: Iris Shaders
optional.why: Shader support. The mod's own visual effects are built to sit alongside Iris rather than fight it, so gates and abilities hold up with shaders on.

companions.name: Solo Leveling: Arsenal
companions.note: The official companion pack. Replaces SLR's daggers, swords, katanas, bows and axes with 3D models. 1.6M downloads, and it covers 1.20.1 and 1.21.1.

companions.name: Solo Leveling Reawakening Server
companions.note: The pack running the official server. If you would rather not assemble anything yourself, start here — it is already put together.

companions.name: Rise of the Dark Sovereign
companions.note: A community pack built on top of SLR, with its own dungeon and ability curation.

notices.title: The Epic Fight addon is gone
notices.body: The Epic Fight compatibility addon is no longer available and is not coming back. Do not go looking for it, and do not install an old copy against a current build — it will not match. **Better Combat is the supported animation path now**, and it is wired into the mod directly.

notices.title: This is the NeoForge branch
notices.body: Version 1.2.0 targets **Minecraft 1.21.1 on NeoForge**. The older Forge 1.20.1 builds are a different branch — worlds and mod lists do not carry across cleanly between them. Back up any world you care about before updating.

steps.title: Install NeoForge
steps.body: Get the **21.1.244** installer or newer for Minecraft **1.21.1** from neoforged.net and run it. Launch the game once on the new NeoForge profile so it creates your `mods` folder.

steps.title: Drop in the mod and GeckoLib
steps.body: Put the SLR jar and a **4.9.x** GeckoLib jar into `mods`. Two files, same folder. Version-matching GeckoLib matters more than people expect — a 5.x build fails.

steps.title: Add the optional pieces
steps.body: Better Combat if you want proper weapon animations, Sodium if you want frames. Both go in the same `mods` folder. Neither is required to play.

steps.title: Add the Arsenal pack
steps.body: Download **Solo Leveling: Arsenal** and drop it in `resourcepacks`, then enable it in **Options → Resource Packs**. It is a texture pack, not a mod, so it does not go in `mods`.

steps.title: Create a world
steps.body: World creation has a **Solo Leveling** tab: Story Mode, progression speed, difficulty, XP rate, job change level, gate access and death rules. You can leave every one of them alone and play the intended defaults.

server.title: Playing with other people
server.body: Every player and the server need the **same mod version and the same GeckoLib version**. Mismatches disconnect rather than degrade. Optional client-side mods — Sodium, Iris, the Arsenal pack — do not need to match, since the server never sees them.
